messages:
sam-cs: Heads up on Nimbus renewal — buyer asked to shorten from 12mo to 9mo and pay via PO under a different legal entity. They want invoice to show their EU VAT ID. Can we accommodate without changing rates?

arin-am: Had a call with Oliver (buyer). He said procurement can issue PO once the SOW lists the new bill-to entity and VAT ID. He explicitly wants a 9-month term and a prorated invoice for the last quarter.

kyle-sales: Pricing team confirmed price stays the same on a per-month basis. We can do 9mo with prorate. No discount required.

toni-finance: Need to confirm tax entity mapping. If the bill-to entity != contract entity we require a signed entity amendment and tax paperwork (EU VAT certificate). Also AP needs vendor code on invoice header.

mira-legal: If they're switching legal entity, that's more than a payment method change. We need the entity name exactly as it appears on their PO + a signature block for that entity. Also add a clause: "Entity assignment acknowledged" to prevent ambiguity.

sam-cs: Ok — action plan: (1) draft short amendment to change bill-to + term to 9mo + prorate language, (2) include signer block for new entity, (3) send via DocuSign for their procurement signer and countersign. Agree?

kyle-sales: Agree. Keep it narrowly scoped: term length + billing entity + VAT ID. Nothing else.

bot-docusign: Draft envelope created from template: renewal_entity_amend_v1. Link: https://docusign.internal/envelope/draft/xyz789

toni-finance: Also request from them: vendor code (for our invoice), EU VAT cert (if available), and the legal entity registration number. Without VAT cert our finance team will treat invoice differently.

arin-am: I'll ask Oliver to attach PO + VAT cert and confirm signer's name/email. He said procurement contact is laura.proc@Nimbus.io and PO will be 77892.

mira-legal: When you get the signer details, send to me. I'll add the entity signature block and the assignment clause. Add a one-liner: "Prorate calculation: final invoice will be pro rata for unused months; invoice net 30."

sam-cs: Noted. Also flagging that if the legal entity on the PO != our current customer entity, we might need approvals from Sales Ops. @kyle-sales can you confirm we have account mapping authority for this change?

kyle-sales: Confirmed — Sales Ops ok with mapping for this account provided legal and finance sign off.

bot-invoice: Invoice template updated: placeholders added: VENDOR_CODE: _____, VAT_ID: _____, BILL_TO_ENTITY: _____

toni-finance: Good. Once we have PO + VAT cert, finance can generate prorated invoice within 1 business day after countersign.

arin-am: PO & VAT cert forwarded: https://files.example/nimbus/PO-77892.pdf ; VAT cert: https://files.example/nimbus/VAT-77892.pdf. Signer: laura.proc@Nimbus.io (Laura Proc, Head of Procurement).

sam-cs: Adding Laura to envelope and sending now.

bot-docusign: Envelope sent to laura.proc@Nimbus.io at 2026-03-23T09:10Z. Status: sent.

mira-legal: Quick reminder: capture the exact legal entity string from the PO and paste into amendment. If their VAT cert lists a holding company name we need to reconcile.

laura.proc: (external) Signing now.

bot-docusign: Envelope update: signed by Laura Proc at 2026-03-23T09:42Z. Awaiting Redwood countersign.

sam-cs: Countersigned.

bot-docusign: Envelope completed: fully executed at 2026-03-23T09:45Z. Exec doc: https://files.example/nimbus/Exec-77892.pdf

toni-finance: Received executed amendment. Generating prorated invoice now. Invoice will show PO# 77892, vendor code: NIM-443, VAT_ID populated.

kyle-sales: Great — please confirm that the contract term in our systems shows 9 months going forward.

sam-cs: Updated account record to 9mo term and uploaded executed amendment. Marking renewal as completed. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
